name: Neck isometrics
summary: Press the head into your own hand — forward, back, each side — without letting it move.
setup: Sit tall. Place a palm on the forehead and press the head into it, not moving. Hold five seconds. Repeat with the hand on the back of the head, then each side.
why: Nothing moves by design. Logged by hand.
contraindications: Dizziness or headache during the press.

faults.label: Head moving
faults.tip: The hand and head cancel each other out; if the head moves, ease off.

faults.label: Pressing too hard
faults.tip: These are gentle holds. A maximal push provokes the neck rather than training it.

faults.label: Holding the breath
faults.tip: Count out loud through the hold.

faults.label: Head moving
faults.tip: The hand and head push against each other and neither wins. Any movement means too much force.

points.t: Still, pressing evenly into the hand.
